name: rung3_declared_variants
claim: Every variant declared for check2 in data/model_matrix.yaml, all penalties, none omitted, with multiple-testing status. 36 tests in the grid, so Bonferroni alpha is 0.00139 and roughly 1.8 rows are expected to clear an uncorrected 0.05 by chance. Seven rows clear uncorrected; after correction only the base embedding under L2 and the three planted positive-control rows survive. The three baselines clearing uncorrected fall within the expected false-positive count. Note the permutation p floor is 0.001, only marginally below the Bonferroni threshold, so the test resolves nothing finer.
